names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Ιουνίου, «Άγιοι Ιούστος, Ιουστίνος, Χαρίτων, Χαρίτω η παρθένος, Ευέλπιστος, Ιέραξ, Παίων και Λιβεριανός», with the rank words and the epithet η παρθένος left off.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιοι Ιούστος, Ιουστίνος, Χαρίτων, Χαρίτω η παρθένος, Ευέλπιστος, Ιέραξ, Παίων και Λιβεριανός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The company is enumerated, so it is one folder per member**: the page prints a separate heading for each of the eight and a separate epigram for each name. Four of the eight the corpus already keeps from doxologia's 1 iunie — Justus, Justin, Chariton and Valerian — and this Charito is the first of the four it did not. **She is not Chariton.** The two names stand side by side in the one line, the page's own epigram treats them as two — «Θείος Xαρίτων και Xαριτώ παρθένος, Tμηθέντες ευμοιρούσι θείων χαρίτων» — and the calendar marks her a virgin and him not. No year is given for the company, so the folder has no `dates`; the page dates the persecution only by naming Marcus Aurelius. No hymn is printed for any of the eight.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
